text: NATIONAL HEALTH AUTHORITY (NHA) - MINISTRY OF HEALTH & FAMILY WELFARE AYUSHMAN BHARAT - PRADHAN MANTRI JAN AROGYA YOJANA (AB-PMJAY) OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES 1. OVERVIEW & SCALE: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme. It provides health cover of Rs 5,00,000/- per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families (approximately 55 crore beneficiaries) forming the bottom 40% of the Indian population. 2. KEY BENEFIT FEATURES: - Cashless and paperless access to services at point of care across any empaneled hospital (public or private) nationwide. - Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses including diagnostics and medicines. - No restriction on family size, age, or gender. - All pre-existing conditions are covered from day one of scheme rollout. - Benefits portable across all 36 States and Union Territories of India.

AB-PMJAY OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES (Page 2) 3. BENEFICIARY IDENTIFICATION: Target beneficiaries identified based on deprivation and occupational criteria of Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) for rural and urban areas respectively: - Rural: Families living in one room with kucha walls/roof, female-headed households with no adult male member aged 16-59, disabled member households, SC/ST households, landless manual casual labor households. - Urban: Beggars, ragpickers, domestic workers, street vendors, cobblers, construction workers, plumbers, transport workers, sanitation workers. 4. HEALTH BENEFIT PACKAGES (HBP): Over 1,949 treatment procedures covering Cardiology, Oncology, Orthopedics, Neurosurgery, Urology, and Polytrauma. All treatments provided free of cost to the cardholder with zero balance billing.

PHARMACEUTICALS & MEDICAL DEVICES BUREAU OF INDIA (PMBI) PRADHAN MANTRI BHARTIYA JANAUSHADHI PARIYOJANA (PMBJP) 1. OBJECTIVE: To make quality generic medicines available at affordable prices to all citizens, especially the poor and disadvantaged, through dedicated outlets called Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendras (PMBJK), thereby reducing out-of-pocket healthcare expenses. 2. PRODUCT BASKET: - The product basket of PMBJP comprises over 2,040 quality generic medicines and 300 surgical items. - Covers all major therapeutic categories: Cardiovascular, Anti-diabetic, Anti-infectives, Anti-allergic, Gastrointestinal, Nutraceuticals, Oncology, and Dermatology. - Prices of Jan Aushadhi medicines are 50% to 90% cheaper than the market prices of branded medicines. - All medicines are procured only from WHO-GMP compliant manufacturers and tested at NABL-accredited laboratories. 3. SPECIAL PRODUCTS: Jan Aushadhi Suvidha Oxo-Biodegradable Sanitary Napkins available at only Rs 1/- per pad across all Jan Aushadhi Kendras.

PM JANAUSHADHI SCHEME (Page 2) 4. INCENTIVE FOR OPENING JAN AUSHADHI KENDRA: - Financial incentive of up to Rs 5.00 lakh provided to Kendra owners (disbursed @ 15% of monthly purchases, subject to maximum of Rs 20,000/- per month). - One-time special additional incentive of Rs 2.00 lakh for Kendras opened by Women Entrepreneurs, SC/ST, Divyangjan, and in North-Eastern states / Aspirational districts. - 20% trade margin on MRP for store owners on generic drugs and 10% on surgical items.
